data.claim: The ci scratch merge (ddflow/services/ci/scratch.py merge_tree) disables hooks (core.hooksPath=/dev/null) and never re-records the after_merge pins, so a base that moved leaves the branch's generated README missing the later editor's knobs; the merged tree is inconsistent and test_readme_knob_table/test_readme_toc fail.
data.falsifier: If the after_merge pin is re-recorded in the merged scratch tree, its generated file reflects the merged config (count=4), not the stale '3'.
data.mechanism: merge_tree merges base into ref without the post-merge pins-regen hook (B36c484af97), then runner._stale_pins only CHECKS (regenerate check=True, bounded=True) and this machine sets ci.pins_precheck=false, so nothing re-records the fast after_merge pins (README regions, default.toml).
data.probe: Standalone uv-run script: drift a pinned repo (branch adds 'z', main adds '0'), call CI.merge_tree(repo, sha, 'main', cfg=Config.load(repo)) and read count.txt in the merged tree.
data.probe_output: With cfg: count.txt == '4\n' (regenerated, why.kind=ok). Without cfg (pre-fix behavior): count.txt == '3\n' (stale).
data.question: Why do the README knob/TOC tests fail as new in ci when main added knobs, even though the branch passes alone?

evidence.note: R7b082cf6b5 CONFIRMED: a drifted scratch merge (main adds a knob after the branch forked) leaves count.txt stale at '3'; re-recording the after_merge pins in merge_tree makes it '4' (merged config). Standalone uv-run probe output captured.
